bots.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
bots.strategy: Holds up to 6 assets in confirmed uptrends (above SMA200 and SMA50, positive 60-bar return, Supertrend up), ranked by a blend of 60- and 20-bar momentum ranks and Sharpe rank with a bonus for current holdings. Inverse-volatility weights capped at 30%, total exposure scaled by market breadth. Rebalances about every periodsPerYear/70 bars and exits early when a holding falls 5% below its SMA50.

bots.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
bots.strategy: Holds up to 5 assets above both SMA50 and SMA200 with the best 60-bar return per unit of volatility, sized by inverse volatility and capped at 40%. Rebalances about monthly with a 6% drift band to save fees, stops out any position down 20% from entry, and dials exposure down when breadth is weak, SPY is below its 200-day average or VIX is above 30.

bots.name: Momentum Five
bots.strategy: Every 7 bars holds the five assets with the best 60-bar return that trade above their 200-bar average. Goes to cash when nothing qualifies.

bots.name: HODL
bots.strategy: Buys every listed asset in equal weight on the first bar and never sells. The market itself, minus fees.

bots.name: Monkey
bots.strategy: Throws darts: every 10 bars it holds three random assets. The baseline every strategy must beat.
